---
title: "02 · Image Infection + Dose-Response"
subtitle: "CQ1 image-based antiviral assay: 2-GMM gating, per-plate normalization, co-primary EC50, and outlier masking"
description: |
  Analyzes per-cell fluorescence data from image-based infection assays (e.g., CQ1 microscope).
  Performs 3-step singlet/cell-cycle QC, per-plate two-anchor normalization (Mock/VO), population 2-component GMM gating, 
  and side-by-side co-primary 4PL dose-response analysis (% Infection and Normalized Intensity) with Prism-style outlier masking.
categories: [infection, virology, dose-response, microscopy, gmm, hcs]
---

## Overview

| Item | Details |
|------|---------|
| **Input** | Per-cell CSV files (nucleus channel + virus channel) per plate from CQ1 or similar HCS software |
| **Key packages** | `tidyverse`, `mclust`, `minpack.lm`, `MASS`, `ggridges`, `scales`, `ragg` |
| **Statistics** | Population 2-GMM Gating · Per-Plate Normalization · Binomial-Weighted 4PL (EC50) · Outlier Masking · Parametric Bootstrap 95% CIs |
| **Output** | Gating QC · Ridgeline plots · Formatted tables · % Infection & Intensity Dose-Response Curves |
| **Download** | [template.Rmd](template.Rmd) |

::: {.callout-tip}
**When to use this template:** You have single-cell or per-well fluorescence data from an image-based antiviral assay across single or multiple plates and want to perform robust 2-GMM gating, per-plate normalization, and co-primary 4PL dose-response analysis.
:::

::: {.callout-note}
All plots use **Arial 8pt** global theme tuned for **4 × 3 inch** publication figures.
TIFF output at 600 dpi with LZW compression via `ragg`.
:::
